Applies any pending Entity Framework Core migrations for the specified database context during application startup. public static IApplicationBuilder DatabaseMigrate<TContext>(this IApplicationBuilder app, TimeSpan? timeout = null) where TContext : DbContext Parameters app IApplicationBuilder The IApplicationBuilder instance. timeout TimeSpan? An optional timeout for the migration command. If specified, the command timeout is temporarily set to this value during migration and then restored to its original value. Returns IApplicationBuilder The IApplicationBuilder so that additional calls can be chained. Type Parameters TContext The type of the DbContext to migrate. Examples // Apply migrations with default timeout app.DatabaseMigrate<MyDbContext>(); // Apply migrations with 5-minute timeout app.DatabaseMigrate<MyDbContext>(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5)); Remarks This method creates a temporary service scope to resolve the database context and applies any pending migrations by calling the Database.Migrate() method. If a timeout is specified, it is applied only during the migration operation and the original timeout is restored afterward. If the context or database is not available, the method returns without throwing an exception.

Adds the composite localizer to the service collection, enabling multiple localization sources with prefix-based routing and fallback resolution. public static IServiceCollection AddCompositeLocalizer(this IServiceCollection services, IDictionary<string, Type>? namedResourceTypes = null, IEnumerable<Type>? unnamedResourceTypes = null) Parameters services IServiceCollection The IServiceCollection to add services to. namedResourceTypes IDictionary<string, Type> A dictionary of named resource types where the key is the prefix name (e.g., "Errors") and the value is the resource type. Named localizers can be targeted using prefix syntax (e.g., "Errors:ValidationFailed"). unnamedResourceTypes IEnumerable<Type> A collection of resource types to be used as fallback localizers. These are searched when a key is not found in named localizers. Returns IServiceCollection The IServiceCollection so that additional calls can be chained. Examples services.AddCompositeLocalizer( namedResourceTypes: new Dictionary<string, Type> { ["Errors"] = typeof(ErrorResources), ["Messages"] = typeof(MessageResources) }, unnamedResourceTypes: new[] { typeof(SharedResources) } ); Remarks This method registers all necessary IStringLocalizer<T> instances and a scoped CompositeLocalizer that combines them. Named resource types take precedence when using prefix syntax. Unnamed resource types are used for fallback resolution when a key is not found in any named localizer. Duplicate types between named and unnamed collections are automatically handled, with named registrations taking precedence.

index.html.title: Introduction | Nuv Tools Framework Docs
index.html.summary: Introduction Here you will find the libraries of the Nuv Tools framework, which aim to assist in the development of cross-platform .NET applications. Nuv Tools Common Library Common library for Web, Desktop and Mobile (MAUI) applications. NuvTools.Data Library containg helpers to manipulate data. NuvTools.Data.EntityFrameworkCore Library containg helpers to manipulate data using Entity Framework Core. NuvTools.Data.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer Library containg helpers to manipulate data using Entity Framework Core for SQL Server. Nuv Tools Resources for .NET Contains the common resources for using in the libraries and projects of Nuv Tools. NuvTools.AspNetCore Common library with helpers to use with ASP.NET Aplications. NuvTools.AspNetCore.EntityFramework EntityFramework Core helper library to use with ASP.NET Aplications. NuvTools.Notification.Mail Use the NuvTools.Notification.Mail library and the NuvTools.Notification.Mail.Smtp as infrastructure. NuvTools.Report Report base library to support PDF and Sheet infrastructure libraries. NuvTools.Report.Sheet Helper report library to work with Excel/CSV. NuvTools.Report.Pdf Helper report library to work with PDF. NuvTools.Security.Models Library Contains models to be used by security modules. NuvTools.Security.AspNetCore Library Common library for security purposes in ASP.NET Core. NuvTools.Security Library Common library for security purposes. NuvTools.Security.Identity.Models Contains models to be used with ASP.NET Identity modules. NuvTools.Security.Identity.AspNetCore Library to use with ASP.NET Identity modules on server-side. NuvTools.Security.Identity Helper library to be used with ASP.NET Identity. NuvTools.Storage Contains base and helper classes to manipulate storages such as Microsoft Azure Storage. NuvTools.Storage.Azure Contains helper classes to manipulate Microsoft Azure Storage. Nuv Tools Validation Library Validation library for Web, Desktop and Mobile (MAUI) applications.
